_comment: FROZEN cross-client conformance vectors for gero-xprove/v1 (Cross-Device Proving).
Mirrored byte-for-byte by gero-ios. Generated from this repo's implementation and
asserted against it by proveSession.spec.ts / proveEnvelope.spec.ts, so this file and
the code cannot drift: change one without the other and the suite fails.
DO NOT EDIT BY HAND to make a test pass. If a value here needs to change, the wire
contract changed, which means a coordinated change with gero-ios and a version bump.
The KDF is the trap: 'HKDF-BLAKE2b' has two readings that do not interoperate. This
contract is RFC 5869 HKDF with HMAC-BLAKE2b-512 over UNKEYED BLAKE2b (ipad/opad,
128-byte block), 64 zero-byte salt, 64-byte PRK. It is NOT BLAKE2b's native keyed
mode, which is what libsodium's crypto_generichash gives you and what iOS shipped
first. HMAC-BLAKE2b is not a stock primitive on iOS (libsodium exposes HMAC-SHA512;
CryptoKit has no BLAKE2b), so iOS hand-rolls HMAC over unkeyed BLAKE2b-512 — vector
`prk` below is what makes that safe to verify independently of the final keys.

session._comment: Fixed ephemeral secrets — TEST ONLY. Real jobs mint a fresh pair per job.

negativeControl._comment: BLAKE2b native keyed mode over the same shared secret. If your PRK equals THIS, you implemented the wrong construction.

chunk._comment: Sealed under keyP2d. AAD binds version|reqId|dir|seq|count — this is why chunks need no per-chunk signature.

payloadDigest._comment: blake2b-256 over the PLAINTEXT payload, never the ciphertext.

_comment: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 subject, using the EXISTING relay device identity (the same
key that signs SIGN_RESPONSE) — XDP adds no new pairing. Signing keys below are
derived from all-0x09 (phone) and all-0x08 (desktop) seeds, test only.
`to` is inside every subject: these frames carry ephemeral key material, so
redirection must be unforgeable rather than merely detectable.

limits._comment: Set from iOS's ledger-v8 8.1.0 measurements: unshielded 1-in/1-out + 1 DUST spend = 1685 B unproven -> 3627 B proven; range across shapes 1.5-9 KB -> 3.6-60 KB.
